description: This source file implements utility functions for handling X.509 certificates on Apple platforms, including creating certificates from bytes, converting between SecCertificateRef and X509Certificate, calculating SHA256 fingerprints, and extracting certificate chains from trust objects.

methods.name: CertBufferFromSecCertificate
methods.description: Converts a SecCertificateRef to a CRYPTO_BUFFER wrapped in a UniquePtr.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a SecCertificateRef from raw byte data.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates a SecCertificateRef from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateArrayForX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates an array of SecCertificateRef objects from an X509Certificate, including intermediates.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromSecCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a SecCertificateRef and its chain.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates the SHA256 fingerprint of a SecCertificateRef.

methods.name: CertificateChainFromSecTrust
methods.description: Extracts the certificate chain from a SecTrustRef object.
